story.iWant: a real-time transparency dashboard that shows all browser operations
story.soThat: I can verify Toubkal Browser's privacy claims and understand what data is being processed
story.tasks: Task 1: Design and implement real-time operation log viewer Task 2: Implement consent history display Task 3: Create audit export functionality Task 4: Set up dashboard authentication and access Task 5: Integrate with audit trail system Task 6: Create comprehensive test suite

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: Real-time operation log viewer functional and accessible Consent history display working with detailed decision logs Audit export functionality (JSON/CSV) working properly Dashboard accessible via toubkal://audit with proper authentication Dashboard integrated with audit trail system and shows 100% of operations

artifact.reason: Existing audit logging service that needs integration with transparency dashboard for real-time data streaming
C++ audit trail implementation that dashboard needs to connect to via Mojo IPC
Existing routing system that needs extension for toubkal://audit page
Feature-first structure where transparency-dashboard feature should be implemented

packages.package: React framework for dashboard UI components and real-time updates
Testing framework for dashboard component and integration testing
TypeScript for type-safe audit data handling and UI components
Mojo IPC for communication between dashboard UI and C++ audit system
LevelDB for audit log storage and retrieval

story-context.constraints: Follow Chromium C++ style guide for audit system integration Use TypeScript strict mode (no 'any' types) Implement Result<T> pattern for error handling Follow Toubkal coding rules for file naming and structure Real-time data streaming without page refresh Privacy-safe audit data display (no sensitive information leaks)

tests.standards: Unit tests: Vitest + React Testing Library for dashboard components. Integration tests: Audit system integration, Mojo IPC communication. E2E tests: Complete dashboard workflow, authentication, export functionality. Real-time tests: WebSocket/Server-Sent Events streaming validation. Security tests: Authentication bypass prevention, data export sanitization. 80% minimum test coverage. AAA pattern for all tests. Result<T> pattern for audit data handling. Mock audit system and LevelDB for isolated testing.
tests.locations: src/toubkal/app/features/transparency-dashboard/ - Dashboard component unit tests src/integration/ - Integration tests for audit system connectivity and real-time streaming src/test/e2e/ - End-to-end tests for complete dashboard workflows src/test/security/ - Security tests for authentication and data export validation
tests.ideas: AC1-Real-time-log-viewer: Test log streaming interface, filtering and search, real-time updates without refresh, log categorization AC2-Consent-history-display: Test consent decision timeline, detailed information display, filtering and search, export functionality AC3-Audit-export-functionality: Test JSON export with complete audit data, CSV export compatibility, filtering and date ranges, integrity verification AC4-Dashboard-authentication: Test toubkal://audit routing, user authentication, session management, access logging AC5-Audit-system-integration: Test complete audit trail integration, real-time data streaming, 100% operation coverage, audit data verification
